steps.title: Know your models
steps.html:
Type each gray word in the Filter models box.

@MODELS@

This list is also on the Canvas tab in VR.

steps.title: Go on location
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Island in Filter environments. Click Island Town, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the scene
steps.html:
Press the top button on your right controller, then click Models. Put the White Smoke Effect up in the air. Aim the Pipe at the water. Drop the Water Bottle on the ground. Then add the Seagull and the Frog.

✋ Grab a model with the palm trigger. Use both palm triggers to make it bigger or smaller.
🗣 Say it out loud: “This is ___ pollution. It harms the ___ because ___.”

steps.title: Take the shot and send it
steps.html:
Stand back so the whole scene fits. Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Move the models, take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Add one more piece of water pollution: Fishing Net

vr.full: Your photo shows the smoke, the pipe and the bottle, plus the Seagull and the Frog.

labels.done: You found all 4. Land, water and air pollution were all in one town. Nice work, crew!
labels.lens: Drag me onto a question mark, or just tap one.
labels.q2: What kind of pollution is it?

studio.look: This picture is a model, a simple drawing of a town. Pollution is harmful stuff that ends up where it does not belong. Six things have a question mark beside them. Four of them pollute.
studio.do: Tap a question mark, or drag the magnifying glass onto it. When you find pollution, tap what kind it is.

voice.brief: Welcome to town, crew. We film Scene 23, Three Kinds of Trouble. Show me land, water and air pollution, then take the shot.
voice.step1: Before your headset goes on, meet your five models. Learn each gray search word. You will type it in VR.
voice.step2: Put on your headset. Click Explore, type Island, and pick Island Town. Then click Begin Solo.
voice.step3: Put smoke in the air, the pipe by the water and the bottle on the ground. Add the gull and frog. Name each kind.
voice.extra: Got time? Add one more piece of water pollution. That shot is just for VR crews.
voice.step4: Step back so the whole scene fits. Click Library, then Camera, and take the shot. Then send it to Canvas.
voice.step5: Press the Meta button and click Quit. Then open Canvas. Your photo should be waiting there.
voice.studio: No headset today? Come to the studio. Find four spots that pollute the town. Then tell me what you think.
